name: Clef-Flash
summary: The smaller, faster Clef (9B) for latency-critical decisions; also reads images. Decision model: it answers typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) with probabilities through a Jev-compatible /v1/systemone endpoint. It does not chat or write text.

practical_baseline.reason: Decision models are not ranked by the chat-model baseline policy; pick by hardware and API.
